description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise (Special Provisions) Act No. 13 of 1989 Order under Section 3
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an order issued under Section 3 of the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, amending excise duty rates on petroleum products. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, the focus is on regulatory changes to tax rates rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The content establishes new legal requirements for excise duties, making it a regulatory matter under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
